title: Distinguish GHZ state and W state
titleZh: 区分 GHZ 态和 W 态
statementMd:
You are given $*N*$ qubits ($2 ≤ *N* ≤ 8$) which are guaranteed to be in one of the two states:

- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/acb08ce15c611d90dc85f731accccd9bbfac8fd3.png) state, or
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6c9f6af141e015f20a73dd1c0e8749da68f71ba6.png) state. Your task is to perform necessary operations and measurements to figure out which state it was and to return 0 if it was GHZ state or 1 if it was W state. - ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/acb08ce15c611d90dc85f731accccd9bbfac8fd3.png) 状态，或
- ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6c9f6af141e015f20a73dd1c0e8749da68f71ba6.png) 状态。

你的任务是执行必要的操作和测量，以判断它们处于哪种状态。如果是 GHZ 状态，则返回 0；如果是 W 状态，则返回 1。执行操作后量子比特的状态无关紧要。
